label: Global thesis variants, scope and defeater transmission
summary: Case 17 reuses Relativism's self-applying no-absolute-truth reading with the explicit content and scope links, the consistent speaker-relative and exemption models, and the local second-order test. Unindexed truth need not be attitude-independent; truth-for should not be collapsed into truth simpliciter. Case 18 reuses Scientism with establishment interpreted as knowledge and empirical establishment as establishment by empirical investigation. The strong dilemma requires self-scope and failure of empirical establishment. The restricted survivor leaves room for nonempirical establishment outside its scope. The exact no-nonempirical consequence of a restricted norm also needs coverage of failing witnesses (SCIENTISM-SCOPE-GUARDED-NONEMPIRICAL-NEGATIVE). No claim is made that F6 itself is a knowledge token produced outside empirical inquiry. Case 19 adds the strict empirical-only self-application argument on the existing Norm. Scope and nonverifiability are open inputs. The analytic-or-verifiable principle and the V4-style proposal are distinct cases; the checked proposal adopts a language for a task without asserting a universal cognitive-significance criterion. See docs/ayer-verification-boundary.md and docs/showcase-verificationism.md. Case 21 reuses the actual-stable truth frame. Scope-restricted construction plus actual-stable calibration and explicit variation of true constructed contents rules out objective truth inside that scope. The finite controls show stable actual truth despite global provenance classification and a populated local variation case with a stable objective truth outside. Reject the inference from constructed vocabulary or social origin of belief to variation of the same content's truth. Case 22 composes acceptance of the package, acceptance leading to low or unassessable reliability of a selected basis, a policy that undercuts that same basis upon the assessment, dependence of all available package support on that basis, and a requirement of undefeated support for warrant. The target is the very package that the same subject accepts. The dependence premise does not imply that there is any support. A low-assessment case leaves the package true and admits thin F6, and omission controls retain package warrant with an alternative basis, no reliability concern, or failure of the policy. The earlier fitness/truth result provides the specific upstream model comparison, not the needed probability or assessment bridge. See docs/notes/plantinga-fitness-truth-boundary.md. All new reconstructions defer attribution. The cases test support for the foundational truth and reasons used by the main case. No refutes edge, new floor marking or root-route proof is asserted.
blocker: For an objective-truth attack on CreedArticlesHold, identify those same root contents with supplied profile contents, defend profile stability as the intended objectivity and the real social-variation bridge, and state which Creed contents are in scope. For an F6 attack, show that every actual thin reason requires an undercut basis. For a warrant attack on the attested founding route, identify a particular affected basis for the recognition or attestation used by the route and establish lack of undefeated alternatives. For the evolutionary-naturalism specialization, specify the naturalism and evolutionary commitments, cognitive basis and relevant reliability standard, defend the conditional assessment and separate defeat policy, and test independent warrant. The prior binary success control supplies neither priors nor likelihoods. For empirical-only knowledge and meaning, reassess when a precise scope and epistemic or verifiability criterion is defended on the same formulations.
